faqs.q: Can I stay home during the replacement?
faqs.a: Yes - all the work happens outside. Just expect significant noise during tear-off and installation.

faqs.q: How do I know if insurance will cover my roof?
faqs.a: Storm damage from hail or wind is typically covered. We provide free inspections and can help you determine whether filing a claim is appropriate.
Yes - we pull the required permits and schedule inspections. You receive both the manufacturer warranty on materials (25-50 years) and our workmanship warranty.

pricing.summary: Roof replacement in Dallas-Fort Worth typically costs between $11,000 and $25,000. Our published price table puts a 2,000 sq ft architectural shingle replacement at $8,500-$12,000 (metal $15,000-$22,000), with most typical 2,000 sq ft homes landing around $12,000-$15,000 once all factors are in. Inspections are free, and every replacement carries the manufacturer warranty (25-50 years) plus our workmanship warranty.
